description: Advisory transport checks for captured requests on the pinned SDK default track1.aniview.com/track endpoint. The producer emits GET or POST, and an object body containing e uses POST. Image queries, opaque strings and buffered arrays retain their source behavior. No field grammar, event enum, MIME, receiver acceptance or track4/avh equivalence is inferred.

params.name: method
params.description: Unchanged SDK t8 chooses only GET or POST. This is source transport advice, not a complete receiver method contract.

params.name: body.e
params.description: Only submitted key presence selects the POST advice. Null, empty, number, array, object and unknown event values remain open.

rules.message: The pinned SDK sends a nonempty object containing an e member using POST. Preserve its opaque event value.
